name: Asian Petroproducts & Exports Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Asian Petroproducts& Exports Ltd manufactures, trades, and exports various petro products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
APPEL manufactures ethylene oxide–based chemicals such as monoethanolamide, diethanolamine, triethanolamine, and various ethoxylates, including lauryl alcohol and stearic acid ethoxylates, used in detergents, personal care, and industrial products. It also trades in plastic products and other chemicals.
